name: sre

findings.message: Silent failure in _cycle_state_write_iter_start: if the locked state write fails (disk full, lock timeout), the state file keeps the stale current_iter from the previous completed iteration, a subsequent resume starts at the wrong iteration, and no warn/log message surfaces why.

When both --resume and --from-stage are active, _runner_resume_rehydrate (line 2946) and _runner_from_stage_preflight (line 3036) each call _artifact_persist_restore independently, performing two redundant git checkout operations against the state branch; no-clobber prevents corruption but the double I/O is unnecessary.

reason: the sre lens found a medium or high or critical problem the change introduced
